name: latch
description: Control the user's signed-in Chrome tabs through the local Latch extension, with tab reuse, per-agent tab groups, and visible browser actions.

interface.shortDescription: Control signed-in Chrome tabs, with a tab group per agent.
interface.longDescription: Latch connects any local agent to your real Chrome session. It reuses existing pages, groups each agent's task tabs under a group named after that agent, and exposes navigation, page actions, screenshots, console, and network activity.
defaultPrompt: Continue in the tab I already have open
Inspect this page and help me finish the task
Research this across a grouped set of tabs
